Q1: D&C Red 28 presents a mixed hazard profile with several data gaps. It is classified as a known hazard (Tier 1) for organ and systemic effects, and current scientific data suggest potential environmental and dermal/eye hazards (Tier 2). However, there is insufficient information (Tier 4) to confidently assess its carcinogenicity, mutagenicity, reproductive, endocrine disruption, or inhalation hazards, although direct studies support a favorable safety profile (Tier 3) for oral hazards.
Q2: D&C Red 28 does not appear on any official lists of concern or low hazard. This absence may be due to a lack of comprehensive evaluation, as indicated by several data-deficient hazard categories in its Tier Profile, or because it is not widely studied for inclusion on such lists.
